questions.note: Signs the TEFAP certification that the household lives at the address and the information is true.

questions.note: Maiden name isn't in the profile.

questions.label: Name of Proxy
questions.note: Someone else who may pick up food; not in the profile.

questions.note: The proxy's address, not the applicant's.
